export_info.description: Read-only export of every implemented Wanderer card, plus the class-agnostic neutral cards in cards/neutral/ (flagged pool_class = neutral) - the four in the belongings pool. card_text is the rules text a real CardView shows outside a fight (deck view / reward screen): no stance, 0 Toll, no conditional highlighted; an HP price is shown on the face's separate HP line (face_hp_line), not in the text. Numbers that move in battle are listed under dynamic_values with their rule and this default.
export_info.generated: 2026-10-04, from the live data at 67d4637 plus Blood Advance, Second Swing, Garnish, Claw Back, Gnaw and Settled Account; Come Due's text to Attack hits (2026-10-18); In the Red (2026-10-19); Go Under (2026-10-19); the Toll package - Second Swing, Come Due, Deny (2026-10-19); the Toll package, part 2 - Leverage, Collateral, Sentence (2026-10-19); Bide reworked, Countersign (2026-10-19); Settled Account all or nothing (2026-10-19); Not So (2026-10-19); Not So's art (2026-10-19); Reckoning reworked (2026-10-19); Take In (2026-10-20); Take In's art (2026-10-20)
generated_from: res://battle/card_view.tscn (face text, type label, HP line, rules size)
export_info.rarity: CardData.rarity: COMMON, UNCOMMON, RARE or ULTRA_RARE (no card is Ultra Rare yet). A pool decides whether a card can drop; rarity only how often among the ones that can. RewardPool.weights is empty in both pools (every entry weight 1.0).
export_info.keeper: The Keeper (field/keeper.tscn) now offers keepsakes, not cards, so no card is in a Keeper pool and in_keeper_pool is gone.
export_info.rules_font_px: The size the card's rules text fits at: the first of 15, 14, 13, 12 px that fits; no card overflows 12.
export_info.upgrades: No upgrade system exists in the current project (CardData has no upgrade fields); upgrade_data is null on every card.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Energy
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Per-turn resource that pays a card's cost; 3 per turn. Gained Energy can stand above that for the turn (In the Red, Come Due); each turn starts on the refill, less what is owed (Come Due's Owed), never below 0.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Toll
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Gained when you lose HP to your own cards. Carries between fights; up to 5 carries to the next floor. Self-inflicted losses only (self-damage, status ticks, stance prices), never enemy hits. Spent by Leverage, Settled Account (5, for 5 block), Bide (4: up to 2 hand cards gain Keep), Countersign (7: a copy of a hand card), Not So (10: the last enemy attack undone and returned), and the three that turn it into time and actions: Second Swing (5: play the last Attack again), Come Due (5: 2 Energy now, 2 less next turn) and Deny (6: an enemy's next action a turn later); each card (or replay) that spends any of it brings every Sentence a turn closer. Reckoning deals what you've spent this fight, spending none. Collateral's HP makes it too.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Grace
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: After enemy hits get through your Block, damage you deal on your next turn wins HP back, up to the largest hit. Wanderer passive; lost at the end of that turn. Self-damage never opens it. Not So undoing an attack closes that attack's share of the window, if it is still open.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Critical
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: At or below 30% of your max HP. (CharacterData.critical_hp_fraction 0.3.) Checked live when an effect resolves. Go Under raises it to 50% for the rest of the fight (the tooltip and the HP bar's tick follow).

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Drain
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Heal for the HP the damage takes from enemies, up to the Drain's number if it has one. Ransom's turn and The Return's trigger Drain. Claw Back's hit Drains too, and Gnaw's once Toll has been spent this turn: an Attack's own blow, so its bonuses are in the heal, Ransom's half comes on top, and it heals only what Grace doesn't reclaim.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Spent
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Removed for the rest of this fight once played. Back in the deck next fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Keep
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Stays in your hand at the end of each turn until played (or until it leaves the hand any other way). Given by Bide; never carried to the next fight. A fight-only copy (Countersign's) goes at the turn's end even with Keep.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Devour
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Remove a card from your hand for the rest of this fight. For each Energy it cost: an Attack makes your Attacks deal 2 more this fight (Teeth); a Skill gives 2 Block at the start of each turn (Marrow). 0-cost cards, Powers and Stances yield nothing. Done by Take In; the Devour button (eat a card, heal 3) is separate - no yield, not counted.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Block
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Absorbs damage before HP; resets at the start of your turn. Last Resort prevents gaining it.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Self-damage
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Bypasses block and absorb, makes Toll, opens no Grace, can kill (Down Payment's, Blood Advance's and In the Red's never take you below 1).

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Stance
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: One stance type at a time, for the rest of the fight. Another copy of the held stance adds a stack; a different stance replaces it at 1. Played stance cards leave the deck's rotation for the fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Power
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Applies a lasting status for the fight; coexists with the stance and other powers. Played power cards leave the deck's rotation for the fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Attack bonus
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Flat extra damage from the stance (x stacks) and a keepsake's status (Keen), paid once per Attack card on its first damage effect - Reckoning included. Lash's further hits take the stance's bonus again, but not Keen's; a Second Swing replay is an Attack again, so it takes the stance's bonus and Keen's if a charge is left.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Cost changes
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Leverage: the next card you play this turn costing at least 1 Energy costs 2 less, several adding up; unused, it ends with the turn. The House Key's free card is the same kind of next-card discount; 0-cost cards pass both by. Collateral: this turn, Energy short of a card's cost is paid at 3 HP each (self-damage), never down to 0 HP.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Countdown (Sentence)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: A status on an enemy, beside its HP as an hourglass and its turns: it deals its damage when the turns run out - 1 off at the start of the enemy's turn, 1 off for each card that spends any Toll, at once when it reaches 0. Several on one enemy each count on their own.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Delayed (enemy)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Deny's status: the enemy's coming turn does nothing and its queued move waits for the turn after - held, not lost; its loop, turn count and escalation wait with it, its statuses still tick, a pain turn due then is spent on it. Removed by that turn; doesn't stack, so a Delayed enemy can't be targeted by another Deny. Its intent keeps its number, dimmed; the hover says it acts next turn. A Delayed packmate answers no Signal. (Stunned, which no card applies, still skips a move outright.)

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Braced (enemy intent)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Brace's mark, on one attack intent the enemy has queued (not the enemy, not its status row - the intent readout shows it): that attack deals 50% less, every hit of every action (both of Bereft's), rounded as before. Valid targets: an attack that will land - not a non-attack, not one landing as a strike back (the Siltjaw's Erupt), not one Stunned, cancelled or interrupted - a Delayed one can, it lands a turn later - and one Brace per intent. Spent once that intent lands; lost if it is replaced, cancelled (Stunned, a pain turn, an interrupt) or its enemy dies first. A Signal's out-of-turn answer neither reads nor spends it.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Garnished (enemy intent)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Garnish's mark, on one attack intent the enemy has queued, under Brace's rule (valid targets, spent and lost the same way): that attack deals 5 less in all, not per hit - its hits soak the 5 in order, none below 0 (Tail Lash 4×3 lands 0, 3, 4) - and each of Bereft's two actions loses its own 5. After Braced's 50%, before Block. One Garnish per intent (Garnish+'s counts); an intent can carry one Brace and one Garnish.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Unbroken (you)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Unbroken's status at Critical: the next enemy Attack against you deals 4 less in all, its hits soaking it in order. After other modifiers, before Block; adds to Garnished on the attacker. Copies add up (two: 8). Gone once an enemy Attack against you resolves; a Defend or other move leaves it.

effects.plain_english: Spend 10 Toll. The card can't be played with less, nor with no enemy attack left to undo (its face fades).

Undo the newest enemy attack this fight that cost you HP and hasn't been undone - the whole attack, every hit of it, counted after your Block (fully blocked attacks, Signal answers and Coiled strike-backs all follow the same rule: on the record only if they cost HP). That HP comes back as a heal (never past max HP, makes no Toll; it can lift you out of Critical). That attack's share of a Grace window still open closes - only its share, and only while that window is open. Return it: deal that much to its attacker, through the attacker's own damage modifiers and Block - not an Attack, so no attack bonus adds to it; a dead attacker takes nothing, and the HP comes back all the same. Each attack can be undone once; a second Not So undoes the one before. Its spend brings every Sentence a turn closer.
